note: Four full-data models (SSL ResNet34, MiT-B2, HRNet-W32, zoom HRNet) with D4 TTA, the crop refiner trained on the TTA maps, and barb growth. The cuts come from the pooled out-of-fold maps of the five-fold system. The refiner IoU cut is 0.32 although the out-of-fold best is 0.28: it follows leaderboard probes.
